about.lead: I am a money coach, and I built these tools for my own community.
paragraphs: My practice is called Stress Less About Money, because that is the whole job. I sit with people, on video, and we put their numbers on the screen together. Not a spreadsheet handed over afterward: the picture forms while we talk, and you watch your own year change shape as we move things around.

I came to this the way most people do, by needing it. The money advice I could find assumed a life I did not have: a certain kind of family, a certain calendar, a certain set of papers already signed. Queer Jewish life has its own costs and its own protections, and nobody was writing them down. So I started writing them down.

The tools on this site are free, and they keep nothing on a server. They came out of the sessions: every one is a question a client asked that deserved a better answer than a guess. They sit beside Money Rooms, the larger household app I build in the open, with the same rules. Blank means not entered. A guess is never turned into a number. Nothing leaves your browser.

What I believe about money is short. It is not a moral report card. Shame is more expensive than any mistake. The tradition already holds two of the best answers there are, a rate for giving and a loan without interest, and a good plan makes room for the people you have chosen, whatever the law calls them.

values.title: Plain words
values.plain: If I cannot say it in a sentence you would use, I have not understood it yet.

values.title: No shame
values.plain: Every number is just a number. We look at it together and then we decide.

values.title: Your household, as it is
values.plain: Partnered, married, more than two of you, chosen family, on your own. The plan fits the shape.

values.title: Nothing leaves your browser
values.plain: The tools store nothing on a server. In sessions, your file stays yours, sealed with a password only you know.

faq.q: Do I need to be Jewish, or queer, to work with you?
faq.a: No. The tools and the practice are built around queer Jewish life, and that is who I am for first. If the way I work sounds right to you, book the call.

faq.q: Is this financial advice? Do you manage money?
faq.a: No. I am a coach, not an advisor or a planner licensed to sell products, and I never touch your accounts. I help you see your numbers clearly and decide. For investments, taxes or law, I will say when it is time to see a professional and help you find one.
A sliding scale, settled on the free call. I do not publish a rate because the same number is generous for one person and impossible for another. Nobody is turned away for money.

faq.q: Can my partner, partners or chosen family join?
faq.a: Yes, in any session. Money is shared in more shapes than the law recognizes, and the plan should be built with the people who share it.

faq.q: What do I need to prepare?
faq.a: Nothing. If you want a head start, try any of the free tools with your own numbers; they stay in your browser and we can look at them together.

faq.q: What if I already tried the tools and got stuck?
faq.a: That is the most common reason people book. Bring the page that stuck.
